actions.name: AUTO_MATCH
actions.description: pairs every open bank line of the month that has exactly one books counterpart under the matching rules

actions.name: MATCH
actions.description: pairs one bank line with one books line

actions.name: UNMATCH
actions.description: undoes the pair of a bank line

actions.name: FIX
actions.description: corrects the amount or the date of an open books line

actions.name: RECORD
actions.description: enters a bank-originated line in the books and pairs it

actions.name: FLAG
actions.description: marks an open books line as a timing difference that clears next month

actions.name: DELETE
actions.description: removes a books line that was entered twice

goal.text: Reconcile the books to the bank statement for three months, one month at a time. A month closes when every bank line of it is paired or recorded and every books line of it is paired or flagged. The ledgers are bank.csv and books.csv in the working copy the observation's workdir names; read them with your own tools.
